description: Score the user's answers to a GATE Daily set the way GATE does (a wrong MCQ costs 1/3 or 2/3 of its marks; MSQ and NAT have no negative marking and no partial credit) and get the answer, worked solution and a note to remember for every question. Call it once, after the user has answered; questions left out count as skipped. For a signed-in user the set is saved to their record (the first submission of a set stays).

answers.description: Question number to answer: an option letter for MCQ ("b"), every chosen letter for MSQ (["a","c"]), a number for NAT ("12.5").

date.description: The set's date, YYYY-MM-DD, as get_daily_set or get_subject_set returned it.

subject.description: For a subject set: its subject code, as get_subject_set returned it. Leave out for the daily set.

times.description: Milliseconds spent per question, when known (the quiz card sends it).

name: submit_answers
title: Submit answers
